brief:
Dozens of Gaza students holding Italian university scholarships remain trapped in the territory while facing bureaucratic obstacles to their departure, Al-Monitor reported. The qualified students, who won competitive placements at Italian institutions, have been unable to leave despite the ongoing conflict in Gaza. More than 200 Palestinian students have reportedly secured scholarships, yet administrative delays continue to prevent their evacuation.

The prolonged wait has left scholarship recipients stranded in what one account describes as a deadly conflict zone, with their educational opportunities at risk. Students have expressed frustration as their paths to study abroad remain blocked by processing delays and administrative hurdles.
